name: Enmity Inversion
body:
School enchantment [mind-affecting]; Level ranger 2

Casting Time 1 swift action

Components V, S

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)

Target one creature, which must be a favored enemy

Duration 1 round/level

Saving Throw Will negates; Spell Resistance yes

For the spell’s duration, you lose any favored enemy bonuses you would normally gain against the target. Meanwhile, the target takes a penalty equal to this favored enemy bonus on all Bluff, Knowledge, Perception, Sense Motive, and Survival checks they make against you. Likewise, they subtract this number from all weapon attack and damage rolls made against you.

Character Options: The Ranger. © 2025, Far Distant Future Publishing; Author: Bryan Mangum.
